title: Explicit Ricci-flat metrics on a special Schoen threefold
summary: We give an explicit convergent representation of the Ricci-flat Kähler metric in a one-parameter family of classes on a fixed special Schoen threefold. The threefold resolves a shifted square-torus quotient with sixteen disjoint elliptic singular curves. Radial Eguchi--Hanson product metrics and fixed flat collars define a positive background with an exact $a^4$ volume defect. Spherical harmonics, tangential Fourier modes, Frobenius recurrences, radial ordered integrals, and the flat quotient heat kernel specify the inverse of the background scalar linearized operator.
